turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, it's Tom calling from Riverside Dental Practice. Is that Emma?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Emma. I'm just calling to confirm your check-up with Doctor Shah next Tuesday, at half past two. Is that still okay for you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me think. I've got a meeting that afternoon, but I should be finished by two.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Lovely. If anything changes, just give us a ring at least a day before, and we can move it for you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Will do. Do I need to bring anything with me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Only a list of any medication you're taking, if it's changed since your last visit. And it's worth arriving five minutes early, as we've got a new check-in screen at reception.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No problem. How long will it take, roughly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About twenty minutes for the check-up. If you need a clean with the hygienist, we can usually book that on the same day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh yes, I'd like that. I haven't had one for a while.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'll put a note on your file, and you can pay at the desk after your appointment, as usual.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're welcome, Emma. See you on Tuesday. Bye for now.
